system.description:
3 Armour Slots. Organic Armour (OPDQ): when it has 2 or fewer Health Points left across all its slots, you may take wounds to repair the same number of its Health Points. Agile: your Speed rises one tier while it is equipped. Muscle Enhancer: +1 Talent Point in Grit while you wear it.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.155
system.summary: 3 Armour Slots. Organic Armour (OPDQ): when it has 2 or fewer Health Points left across all its slots, you may take wounds to repair the same number of its Health Points. Agile: your Speed rises one tier while it is equipped. Muscle Enhancer: +1 Talent Point in Grit while you wear it.

automation.note: Organic Armour (once per Doom Quarter): when this armour has 2 or fewer HP left across all its slots, choose a number of wounds to take on your Lifeline and restore that many HP to the armour. Apply both by hand.
